chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umeyr, from Umar ibn Udhaynah, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), that he said:

Regarding these people who perform exclusive Hajj, when they arrive in Makkah and perform Tawaf of the House, they are free (from Ihram restrictions); and when they say the Talbiyyah, they enter Ihram. Thus, they remain alternating between being free and being bound until they depart to Mina without having performed Hajj nor Umrah.

key_terms.يَعْقِدُ: He binds (enters the state of Ihram)

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling for a pilgrim performing exclusive Hajj regarding Ihram status upon arriving in Makkah?
ai.summary: This narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies the specific ritual status of Hajj al-Mufrad, distinguishing it from Hajj al-Qiran by establishing that the pilgrim remains in a state of freedom (Hill) until the formal declaration of Ihram via the Talbiyyah. This highlights the Shia jurisprudential view that the single Hajj is a continuous state of consecration from the moment of intention and declaration, rather than a sequence of separate Umrah and Hajj rituals, emphasizing the unity of the rite.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Umar Bin Azina,
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘With regards to those who are performing exclusive Hajj, when they arrive in Makkah and perform Tawaaf of the House (Kabah), they are free (from restrictions) of Ihram; but when they exclaim Talbiyya (for the Hajj), they should wear Ihraam. Thus, they would not cease to be free (from restrictions) and being withheld, until they go out to Mina without Hajj nor an Umrah’ (until they return to perform Tawaaf Al Nisa).
en.sarwar: 4. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from ‘Umar ibn ‘Udhaynah who has said the following: “About those who are for Mufrad al-Hajj, abu ‘Abd Allah, Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘

When they arrive in Makkah and perform Tawaf around the House, they come out of the state of Ihram. When they say Talbiyah they assume the state of Ihram, they continue coming out of the state of Ihram and say Talbiyah to assume the state of Ihram until they go out to Mina’ without al-Hajj or al-‘Umrah.’” (Fatwa explains Hadith 3-4 )
